1.description: [Elune] Buffed Cat-a-clysm: Increased the attack and spell power scaling by 20%.
[Elune] Buffed Charred Bite: Now increases the damage of Searing Pain and Devil's Ignition by 15% per stack, increased from 10%.
[Elune] Buffed Charred Bite: Increased the direct damage attack and spell power scaling per combo point by 10%.
[Elune] Buffed Prepared to Crush!: Increased damage of Crush by 18%.
[Elune] Buffed Dragon Roar: Increased base damage and scaling by 20%.
[Elune] Buffed Blind Revenge: Doubled the base damage.
[Elune] Buffed Filthy Tricks: Shadowstep now increases the damage of your next ability by 20%, increased from 10%.
[Elune] Buffed Lone Wolf: Increases the damage of Auto Shot and Hunter abilities by 4/8%, increased from 3/6%.
[Elune] Buffed Fixed a bug where some ranks of Rockbiter Weapon did not properly increase the damage of Upheaval while in the off-hand.
[Elune] Buffed Petrification: The damage now triggers at 4 stacks instead of 5. Reduced max stacks from 5 to 4.
[Elune] Buffed Prison Tactics: Now also reduces the energy cost of your next rogue combo point generating ability by 10%.
[Elune] Buffed Bone Arrow: Lasts for 12 seconds, increased from 9 seconds.
[Elune] Buffed Bone Arrow: Increased the scaling on both the direct and periodic damage by 10%.
[Elune] Buffed Phalanx Strike Phalanx Strike to be 25% more effective for Thrust.
[Elune] Phalanx Strike is now 25% less effective for Dark Intent.
[Elune] Buffed Unrelenting Wrath: Now also triggers the Beast Within talent if known. Triggering The Beast Within this way does not grant CC immunity.
[Elune] Updated the tooltip of Crimson Claws, Frenzied Swipe, Unleashed Fury and Frenzy Shot to be more clear.
[Elune] Buffed Savage Synergy: Now also increases the duration of Tiger’s Fury by 2 seconds.
[Elune] Buffed Double-Clawed: Now doubles the damage increase from your Tiger’s Fury.
[Elune] Buffed Double-Clawed: Increases the periodic damage Rake and Rip by 40%, increased from 30%.
[Elune] Buffed Mongoose Fury: Increases the chance to trigger Sudden Death by 25%, increased from 10%.
[Elune] Buffed Expunge: Increased the base damage and scaling by 30%.
[Elune] Expunge: Added a 2% spell power and ranged attack power coefficient to Cobra's Venom.
[Elune] Fixed a bug with Expunge that caused  Ranged Attack Power to scale improperly, resulting in lower scaling than intended.
[Elune] Buffed Deadly Instinct: Increases the damage of Mongoose Bite and Counterattack by 30%, increased from 20%.
[Elune] Shieldsmasher: Now stacks up to 3 times, from 5.
[Elune] Buffed Shieldsmasher: Increases the damage of Colossus Smash by 50% per stack, increased from 30%.
[Elune] Buffed Shieldsmasher: Increases the duration of Colossus Smash by 3 seconds per stack, increased from 2.
[Elune] Buffed Carving Strikes: Carving Strikes now increases the damage of Glaive Toss on targets affected by Deadly Bite by 12% per stack, increased from 8%.
[Elune] Heavy Arms cooldown reduction can now also trigger from Mongoose Bite and Counterattack.
[Elune] Buffed Insatiable: Increases the damage of Overpower by 25% per stack, increased from 20%.
[Elune] Buffed Taste for Blood: The damage increase for Overpower is now set to 20% from 10%.
[Elune] Buffed Shapeshifter's Fangs: Now stores up to 3 charges, increased from 1.
[Elune] Buffed Ambush Predator: Now also increases the damage of your next Ravage by 30% against monsters.
[Elune] Buffed Spot Weakness: Increased the proc chance to 20% increased from 15%.
[Elune] Fel Infused Weapon: Fel Infused Flames now deals 30% more damage while a Single Two-Handed Weapon is equipped.
[Elune] Fel Infused Weapon: Reduced base damage and scaling of Fel Infused Flames by 15%.
[Elune] Buffed Windfury Weapon: Triggering a Windfury attack no longer has a shared internal-cooldown between weapons.
[Elune] Buffed Primordial Fury: Now deals 10% increased damage per 100 additional rage consumed. 10% when used at 200 rage and 40% when used at 500 rage.
[Elune] Buffed Spiteful Strike: Now deals 10% increased damage per 100 additional rage consumed. 10% when used at 200 rage and 40% when used at 500 rage.
[Elune] Shadow of Death can now also trigger from Ravage.
[Elune] Gloaming Embrace can now also trigger from Ravage.
[Elune] Swift Shadows can now also trigger from Ravage.
[Elune] Fixed a bug where Fired Up was not consumed by Explosive Shot despite empowering it.
[Elune] Shadow Arrow and Blood Arrow can now trigger the cooldown reduction and Shadow Dagger procs from Shadow Powers.
[Elune] Fixed a bug where Synchronize would only heal for 4 ticks instead of 5.
[Elune] Fixed a bug where you could not consume multiple preservation stacks.
[Elune] Fixed a bug where Recovering Prayer would not grant cooldown reduction when consuming Preservation. This effect now has a 1 second ICD
[Elune] Unleashed Fuego: Decreased scaling by 15%.
[Elune] Fuego: Decreased scaling by 15%.
[Elune] Buffed Winters Mantle: Increases the critical strike chance of your next Arctis and Unleashed Arctis by 5% per stack, increased from 3%.
[Elune] Buffed Winters Mantle: Increases the damage of your next Arctis and Unleashed Arctis by 24% per stack, increased from 20%.
[Elune] Gathering Will: Now increases the damage of your next Fuego by 18% per stack, reduced from 20%.
[Elune] Buffed Cauterizing Fire. Doubled the scaling of its periodic heal and added an AP scaling coefficient to Cauterizing Fire.
[Elune] Buffed Lifebloom: Its periodic healing can now critically heal.
[Elune] Buffed Wild Growth: Its periodic healing can now critically heal.
[Elune] Buffed Renew: Its periodic healing can now critically heal.

[Elune] Fixed a bug where combo point based damage over time effects would keep Spell and Attack Power values from applications even if they were refreshed. They will now correctly update their damage to your current AP / SP. This follows the same behavior as all other periodic effects.
[Elune] Fixed a bug where Vampiric Embrace did not increase the healing of Vampire Lord while both were active.
[Elune] Buffed Flames of the Apostate: Increased the range of the heal triggered by Holy Fire to 40 yards to match other heals, increased from 30 yards.
[Elune] Buffed Rooted in Storm: Reduces the cooldown of Living Lightning by 3 seconds, increased from 2 seconds.
[Elune] Buffed Grove Ranger's Agility now increases your ranged attack power by 120% of your agility increased from 100%.
[Elune] Buffed Blooming Shot: Grove Blessing now increases the healing received from Medicinal Sting by 40%, increased from 25%.
[Elune] Buffed Blooming Shot: Increased the duration of Grove Blessing to 15 seconds increased from 7 seconds.
[Elune] Buffed Blooming Shot: Its scaling has been doubled.
[Elune] Buffed Dark Surgeon: Doubled the AP scaling of Dark Surgeons Dark Circle of Healing.
[Elune] Buffed Dark Surgeon: Dark Circle of Healing to now heal 10 party or raid members, increased from 5.
[Area 52] Buffed Harbinger of Pestilence: Increased the scaling of Harbinger’s Bile by 33%.
[Area 52] Buffed Totemic Shatter spells: Increased the base damage and scaling by 40%.
[Both Realms] Buffed Harbinger of Pestilence: now also reduces the cooldown of your Haunt by 0.2 sec per stack.
[Both Realms] Buffed Harbinger of Pestilence: Lasts for 10 seconds, increased from 8 seconds.
[Both Realms] Buffed the Rare Mystic Enchant Soul of the Pyro: Increases the damage of your Soul Fire by 8%, increased from 4%.
[Both Realms] Buffed the Rare Mystic Enchant Pyrolate: Now also increases the damage of Shadowflame.
[Both Realms] Buffed Flame Ascendancy: Increased base damage of Lava Beam by 5%.
[Both Realms] Buffed Flame Ascendancy: Lava Beam now deals Firestorm Damage and can Overload.
[Both Realms] Buffed Immolation Trap. Its periodic damage can now critically strike.

0.description: [Raid Trials] Doubled the amount of Talent Case of Fortunes granted for first time Raid Trial level completions. Anyone who has earned a first time completion bonus prior to this change will receive the additional scrolls in their mail.
Zulian Prower's Shred now deals 200% weapon damage from 300% weapon damage.
[Elune] You now take 5% less damage versus players.

5.description: [Pending restart] Fixed an issue causing the buff from Memento of Tyrande to give way more Spirit than intended in some cases.
[Area 52] Fixed a bug where Master's Tome of Specialization 8-20 required Spec 12 known. It now properly requires Spec 7 known.

6.description: [Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Gurtogg Bloodboil] Corrected an issue where Miasma would be removed if a player died. Miasma now persists through death.
[Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Gurtogg Bloodboil] Corrected an issue where Gurtogg Bloodboil would hold and then delay events by a time equal to his Miasma and Mak'gora cast time.
[Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Gurtogg Bloodboil] Corrected another issue regarding Supremus not chasing and selecting the correct Mak'gora target.
[Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Supremus] Corrected an issue where Supremus would hold and then delay events by a time equal to his Titanic Slam cast time.
[Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Supremus] Corrected another issue regarding Supremus not chasing and selecting the correct target.
[Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Gurtogg Bloodboil] Corrected an issue where Blood Shield would not correctly switch indication on the players Bloodshield capacity.
[Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Illidan Stormrage] Corrected an issue where Shadow Blast dealt less damage then intended to the primary target.
[Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Illidan Stormrage] Shadow Demons can now be fully crowd controlled except for Mind Control, Fear, Horror, Banish effects.
[Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Illidan Stormrage] Illidan Stormrage will no longer give his attention to pets, guardians or totems.
[Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Illidan Stormrage] Illidan Stormrage will now chase after a new target with his Eyebeam if the current target died.
[Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Mother Shahraz] Pets will no longer be picked up by Savage Blades during phase two.
[Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Mother Shahraz] Corrected an issue where Headwind and Side Wind would stay on player for up to a minute after combat ended.

[Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Teron Gorefiend] Corrected an issue where Teron Gorefiend would account player dying outside of Shadow of Death twice for being killed, spawning Shadowy Construct as if two player had died.
[Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Gurtogg Bloodboil] Gurtogg Bloodboil will now end his Mak'gora phase with a Miasma cast.
[Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Gurtogg Bloodboil] Corrected an issue where Gurtogg would not change his attention to his Mak'gora target when challenging a target out of melee range.
[Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Supremus] Corrected an issue where Supremus would fall back into walking speed after starting phase two.
[Pending Restart] [The Black Temple] [Supremus] Corrected an issue where Supremus would keep fixating the same target over and over.

[Pending Restart] [The Battle for Mount Hyjal] [Archimonde] Corrected an issue where Chromie could become permanently insane after completing The Insane Difficulty achievement and then starting Archimonde, demanding to play the encounter without additional help, causing player to be stuck with their choice.
[The Black Temple] [Warlord Naj'entus] Corrected an issue where Naj'entus would not throw his trident into the sewer waters around his room to electrify it.
